package com.agilityactioncamera.detect; import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMap; import java.util.Map; import net.runelite.api.gameval.AnimationID; import net.runelite.api.gameval.ObjectID; /** * What sort of movement an obstacle is. The director uses it to prefer shots * that suit the movement; it is never a camera position. *

* Known obstacles get their kind from a per-course profile. Anything else is * classified from the animation the player plays, so new courses still get * sensible shots. */ public enum ObstacleKind { ZIPLINE, SWING, JUMP, BALANCE, MONKEYBARS, CLIMB, UNKNOWN; /** * Course profiles: object id to kind. Colossal Wyrm first; names come from the gameval constants. */ private static final Map PROFILES = ImmutableMap.builder() // Colossal Wyrm .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_START_LADDER_TRIGGER, CLIMB) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_LADDER_1_TRIGGER, CLIMB) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_LADDER_1_TRIGGER, CLIMB) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BALANCE_1_TRIGGER, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BALANCE_1_TERMITES, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_BALANCE_1_TRIGGER, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_BALANCE_1_TERMITES, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_BALANCE_1_TRIGGER, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_BALANCE_1_TERMITES, BALANCE) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_MULTIJUMP_TRIGGER, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_MULTIJUMP_TERMITES, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_JUMP_1_TRIGGER, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_JUMP_1_TERMITES, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_JUMP_1_TRIGGER, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_JUMP_1_TERMITES, JUMP) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_MONKEYBARS_1_TRIGGER, MONKEYBARS) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_BASIC_MONKEYBARS_1_TERMITES, MONKEYBARS) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_MONKEYBARS_1_TRIGGER, MONKEYBARS) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_ADVANCED_MONKEYBARS_1_TERMITES, MONKEYBARS) .put(ObjectID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_END_ZIPLINE_TRIGGER, ZIPLINE) // Werewolf .put(ObjectID.WEREWOLF_SLIDE_CENTER, ZIPLINE) .put(ObjectID.WEREWOLF_SLIDE_SIDE, ZIPLINE) .put(ObjectID.WEREWOLF_SLIDE_SIDE_MIRROR, ZIPLINE) .build(); private static final Map ANIMATIONS = ImmutableMap.builder() .put(AnimationID.ZIPLINE_BITE, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.ZIPLINE_SLIDE, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_ON, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_WALK, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_JUMP, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_READY, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_OFF, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_ZIPLINE_CAPE_DRAG, ZIPLINE) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_ROPESWING, SWING) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_ROPESWING_LONG, SWING) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_LONGJUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_SPOT_JUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_JUMP_HURDLE, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_JUMP_STONES, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_STEPPINGSTONEJUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.ROOFTOPS_POLE_VAULT, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_LONGJUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_SHORTJUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.VARLAMORE_WYRM_AGILITY_LONGJUMP, JUMP) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_MONKEYBARS_ON, MONKEYBARS) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_MONKEYBARS_OFF, MONKEYBARS) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_MONKEYBARS_WALK, MONKEYBARS) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_MONKEYBARS_READY, MONKEYBARS) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_WALK_LOGBALANCE, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_WALK_LOGBALANCE_READY, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_WALK_LOGBALANCE_STUMBLE, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_WALK_LOGBALANCE_LOOP, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_LEDGE_ON, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_LEDGE_WALK, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_LEDGE_READY, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_LEDGE_OFF, BALANCE) .put(AnimationID.HUMAN_REACHFORLADDER, CLIMB) .put(AnimationID.WYRM_AGILITY_TIGHTROPE_WOBBLE, BALANCE) .build(); /** * Kind from a course profile, or {@link #UNKNOWN}. */ public static ObstacleKind forObject(int objectId) { return PROFILES.getOrDefault(objectId, UNKNOWN); } /** * Kind implied by an animation or pose, or {@link #UNKNOWN}. */ public static ObstacleKind forAnimation(int animation) { return ANIMATIONS.getOrDefault(animation, UNKNOWN); } /** * Whether an animation or pose is distinctive enough to mean "doing agility" without a click to confirm it. */ public static boolean isAgilityAnimation(int animation) { ObstacleKind kind = forAnimation(animation); return kind != UNKNOWN && kind != CLIMB; } }
